All existing tests still pass. Note: manual CLI smoke-testing with env vars was blocked by the sandbox (multi-operation Bash commands require approval that isn't available in this session), so I verified logic by reading the code instead.

**Changes:**
- `src/cli.js`: added `parseDoneArgs`, which strips a trailing `today`/`yesterday`/`YYYY-MM-DD` token from the args and converts it to a `Date`, falling back to today when no such token is present. `done` name can still contain spaces.
- `README.md`: documented the new optional date argument.
- `src/commands.js` / `src/streak.js` unchanged — `done(name, today)` already accepted a `Date`, so no API changes needed there.

`node src/cli.js done read yesterday` and `node src/cli.js done read 2026-09-01` now work; `node src/cli.js done read` still defaults to today.
